title: Performance-Endogenous Stop Geometry and Cost-R Feedback

research_height.transfer_path: Cumulative portfolio performance sets conservative capital; capital sets each initial physical stop and cost/R denominator; those entry contracts must then transmit through stop incidence and stressed lifecycle R across components and periods before portfolio gate interpretation changes.

central_question: Does performance-endogenous conservative capital materially widen volatility-normalized initial stops and dilute stressed cost per R, then broadly reduce stop hazard in higher-capital states enough to require capital-scale normalization of future economic gates?

research_bundle.name: global_capital_tail_geometry_local_time_block_contrast_and_hazard_transmission
lenses: mechanism: derive risk capital and initial stop distance for every lifecycle, normalize by prior 24 completed H1 open-to-open volatility, and compare frozen within-component-period capital tails
natural contrast: within each component-period split chronology into four fixed equal-count blocks and compare above- versus below-block-median capital, excluding ties

portfolio transmission and falsification: test stressed incremental cost/R dilution and stop-rate change pooled, by four periods and six components; report stressed-R quality and chronology correlation without using it as rescue

why_now.current_bottleneck: Unit 067 rejected a same-day risk-clock ratchet and Unit 068 preserved separate RC slots, but neither answers the external memo's central cross-day claim that accumulated performance changes the stop and cost geometry under which lifecycles are judged.
why_now.connection_bridge: The source sets position budget to 4% of conservative capital, fills the physical stop near a 2% gross-risk target, and records planned risk, entry, stop and actual/stressed close values for every CP2 lifecycle. This directly connects realized portfolio state to subsequent stop hazard and cost efficiency.
why_now.perspective_distance: Unit 068 was Program 5 meso strategy-pair dependence. Unit 069 moves to Program 4 micro lifecycle protection with macro feedback, using volatility-normalized entry geometry and within-time capital contrasts rather than pair overlap.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain one later separately declared Lab candidate for capital-scale-normalized risk geometry or gate reporting, while preserving all signals, sessions, holds and components. Do not implement automatically.
why_now.decision_if_false: Preserve the current 4%/12% contract and existing absolute/stressed economic gates without capital-state qualification.
why_now.decision_if_partial: Record accounting-scale drift only and retain no candidate when geometry or cost changes do not transmit broadly to stop hazard.

target: all 2,233 filled and closed CP2 lifecycles across four independent fresh-100-dollar periods and six components
market OPEN births and Passive PLACE-to-FILL births with exact entry, initial stop, volume and planned risk
actual and stressed close values, stop reason, entry time, symbol and component
prior 24 completed H1 open-to-open log-return RMS volatility for US30 or US100 from the immutable three-index export
global within-component-period bottom/top capital tails and local four-block below/above median contrasts
excluded: the incomplete binding event tail, binding-versus-CP2 aggregate stop-rate comparison or component-rank attribution
ATR, tick-path MAE, counterfactual stop hits or any unobserved intralifecycle price path
alternate capital quartile, local-block count, H1 volatility length, timeframe or normalization
component, period, direction, winner, loser or stop-only selector
new stop source, risk fraction, lot ladder, addition step, cost multiple, gate, MQL, Tester, broker/account query or Live action
automatic_followups_forbidden: capital decile, tercile or alternate tail split
P2-only, high-profit-only, stop-only or component-specific scaling
geometric lot ladder or reverse-lot stop implementation
risk, stop, cost, lot, slot, component, EA or Live change

semantics.capital: ConservativeRiskCapital is evaluated at admission and position_budget equals capital times 0.04.
semantics.physical_stop: target_gross_risk equals position_budget times (1-0.25-0.25), and a tick-space binary search selects the farthest stop whose gross loss does not exceed that approximately 2% capital target.
semantics.planned_risk: BufferedPlannedRisk records the risk contract used for admission; derived conservative capital is planned_risk/0.04 and must remain positive and finite.
semantics.cost_role: The immutable stressed close subtracts one additional observed transaction-cost unit from actual close economics, so actual minus stressed is the fixed incremental stress cost used here.

immutable_volatility_proxy_input.role: For each entry, take the last 25 H1 opens strictly before the entry hour and compute RMS of the 24 consecutive log returns; initial stop percent divided by that RMS is the fixed volatility-normalized distance.

frozen_reconstruction.lifecycle: Market OPEN begins a lifecycle. Passive PLACE preserves direction, stop and planned risk; matched FILL supplies actual entry and volume, while EXPIRE creates no lifecycle. CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE supplies actual value_a, stressed value_b and stop reason.
frozen_reconstruction.physical_geometry: absolute entry-to-initial-stop price distance divided by entry price; direct gross stop dollars are distance times volume because the pinned symbols have contract size one; report direct gross stop dollars/planned risk.
frozen_reconstruction.volatility_proxy: RMS of 24 log changes across the last 25 synchronized symbol H1 opens strictly before floor(entry_time to the hour). No current incomplete H1 bar is used.
frozen_reconstruction.global_tails: Within each of 24 component-period cells, use inclusive 25th and 75th conservative-capital quantiles. LOW is at or below q25 and HIGH at or above q75; require q25 below q75 and at least five observations in each tail.
frozen_reconstruction.local_time_blocks: Within each component-period cell sort by entry time and split deterministically into four equal-count rank blocks using floor(4*rank/n). Inside each block, LOW is below and HIGH above that block's median conservative capital; exact median ties are excluded.
frozen_reconstruction.cost_r: incremental stressed cost R equals (actual_net_usd-stressed_net_usd)/planned_risk and must be finite and nonnegative within one ten-thousandth dollar rounding tolerance.
frozen_reconstruction.outcome: stop is close reason DEAL_REASON_SL; stressed R equals stressed_net_usd/planned_risk.
frozen_reconstruction.breadth: For period breadth, pool local LOW/HIGH rows across all components within each period. For component breadth, pool across all periods within each component. No cell is selected by its result.

requirements: All 24 global component-period cells have distinct q25/q75 capital and at least five LOW and five HIGH lifecycles.
Pooled global HIGH/LOW median conservative capital ratio is at least 1.20.
Pooled global HIGH/LOW median volatility-normalized stop ratio is at least 1.20, reaches at least 1.15 in three of four periods and four of six components.
Pooled local-block HIGH/LOW median volatility-normalized stop ratio is at least 1.05, with HIGH greater in three of four periods and four of six components.
At least 0.99 of lifecycles have direct gross stop dollars/planned risk in [0.45,0.55], confirming the native half-budget physical geometry rather than a parser artifact.
Pooled local-block HIGH/LOW median incremental stressed cost-R ratio is at most 0.90.
Local HIGH median cost R is lower than LOW in at least three of four periods and four of six components.
Pooled local-block HIGH minus LOW stop rate is at most -0.02.
Local HIGH stop rate is lower than LOW in at least three of four periods and four of six components.
Pooled local HIGH minus LOW mean stressed R is nonnegative, so fewer stops are not purchased by worse normalized lifecycle economics.

fixed_verdict_rules.complete: PASS_MATERIAL_PERFORMANCE_ENDOGENOUS_RISK_FEEDBACK_RETAIN_SCALE_NORMALIZATION_CANDIDATE when integrity and all geometry, cost-scale and hazard-transmission gates pass.
fixed_verdict_rules.partial: PARTIAL_CAPITAL_SCALE_DRIFT_WITHOUT_BROAD_HAZARD_TRANSMISSION_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity passes and geometry or cost scale passes but the complete result does not.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_material: NO_MATERIAL_PERFORMANCE_ENDOGENOUS_RISK_FEEDBACK_PRESERVE_CURRENT_GATES when integrity passes and both geometry and cost-scale gates fail.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_PERFORMANCE_ENDOGENOUS_GEOMETRY_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any pin, lifecycle, mark, tail, local-block, cost or numerical integrity condition fails.

decision_translation.complete: Retain one future isolated Lab candidate for capital-scale-normalized risk geometry or research-gate reporting; preserve current trading behavior until separately tested.
decision_translation.partial: Record the scale-dependent accounting observation but retain no implementation or gate change because adverse-outcome feedback is not broad.
decision_translation.no_material: Preserve the 4%/12% contract and current absolute/stressed gates without capital-state qualification.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve the observation gap and rotate away after budget exhaustion.

stop_rules: Commit and push declaration, state and Frontier memory before calculating any capital quantile, normalized stop, cost-R, stop-rate or stressed-R contrast.
One implementation-only correction is allowed only if aggregation stops before emitting any target geometry, cost or outcome metric. After any such metric is emitted, make no correction or rerun.
Do not change the 24-H1 proxy, quartiles, four local blocks, 20/15/5/10/2-percent thresholds, breadth, component or period treatment after metrics.
Do not create MQL, run Tester, acquire data, query broker/account state or touch Live.
